items.label: Contribution of common stock to the MasterCard Foundation
Interest income on IPO proceeds which were used for redemption

ngaap.def_note: Full-year 2006 net income, EPS and total operating expenses 'each of which excludes special items': the $395 million non-deductible donation of Class A stock to the MasterCard Foundation, $25 million reserve for litigation settlements and $7 million interest income earned on IPO proceeds used for the Class B redemption.

notes: Release in USD thousands; reconciliation table already in $ millions. ngaap: the reconciliation gives special items only in total below operating income (pre-tax 413, tax 6, net income +407, diluted EPS +3.00); no per-item after-tax split is published. Foundation stock contribution ni=395 is computed: the release states it was not tax deductible and the ETR reconciliation shows net income 50 -> 445 (+395) excluding only the stock donation. Litigation (25) and IPO interest income (-7) combined NI effect = 407 - 395 = +12 (computed, not split); their ni/eps left null, so the NI/EPS self-check cannot close at item level (total bridge 50 + 407 = 457 and 0.37 + 3.00 = 3.37 tie). opex self-check 3097 - 420 = 2677 OK; oth 65 - 7 = 58 OK. adj.etr 35.4 is from the separate 'Reconciliation to Effective Tax Rate', which excludes only the stock donation (also = 250/707 from the main table). kpi: rev_g_cn null (release says currency had a 'negligible impact' on full-year revenue; no FX-adjusted rate stated). gdv_g_local 14.9 is from the release's twelve-month operating-performance table (Worldwide, local), as the text gives GDV growth only for Q4 (13.8%). Full-year processed-transaction and cross-border growth not stated in the release text (Q4 processed transactions +17.4%); the 10-K states processed transactions +17.5% and cross-border volumes +14.7% for 2006 but these are not release figures, so left null. cards_bn 0.817 = 817 million MasterCard-branded cards at 31-Dec-2006 (excludes Maestro/Cirrus). revcat: the FY2006 10-K does not use the legacy five-category presentation; it presents operations fees (seven components less rebates) and assessments (gross assessments less rebates and incentives). Recorded as presented with basis 'operations_fees_assessments' (not one of the schema's two bases). Lines sum to 3,326 = net revenue. No 10-K recasts 2006 into the legacy categories (the FY2009 10-K recast covers 2007-2009 only).

items.label: Other income related to a settlement agreement to discontinue the company's sponsorship of the 2010 and 2014 World Cup soccer events

ngaap.def_note: Full-year 2007 net income, EPS and total operating expenses 'each of which excludes special items': a $3.4 million litigation settlement reserve and $90 million other income from the settlement to discontinue sponsorship of the 2010 and 2014 World Cups. Redecard gains (after-tax $254 million, $1.87 per share) were NOT excluded.

notes: Release in USD thousands; reconciliation in $ millions. Litigation item shown as 3 in the table (3,400 thousand = $3.4m in the income statement and text). ngaap: only total special-item effects published: pre-tax -87, tax +30, net income -57, diluted EPS -0.42; per-item ni/eps not published, left null (item-level NI/EPS self-check cannot close; totals tie: 1086 - 57 = 1029, 8.00 - 0.42 = 7.58). opex 2959 - 3 = 2956 OK; oth 563 - 90 = 473 OK. adj.etr null: release gives no adjusted 2007 ETR (computed 556/1584 = 35.1%; the FY2008 release later shows a 2007 non-GAAP ETR of 35.0% excluding litigation only). kpi: rev_g_cn null - release says currency 'contributed 3.1% of the increase' (22.3 - 3.1 = 19.2 would be computed, not stated). gdv_g_local 14.4 from the twelve-month operating-performance table (text gives Q4 only: 15.2%). Full-year processed transactions and cross-border growth not stated (Q4: +17.2% and +27.7%). cards_bn 0.916 = 916 million MasterCard-branded cards. revcat: FY2007 10-K presents operations fees / assessments (basis 'operations_fees_assessments'); lines sum to 4,067 vs net revenue 4,068 (rounding, within +-1). Legacy five-category recast of 2007 from the FY2009 10-K added as fy_legacy_recast (sums to 4,067; within +-1).

items.label: Gain from the termination of a customer business agreement

ngaap.def_note: Special items for full-year 2008: a $1.65 billion charge for the American Express antitrust settlement, an $827.5 million net charge for the Discover settlement, a $6 million charge for a California consumer protection settlement, and a $75 million gain in other income from the termination of a customer business agreement. Redecard gains ($0.42 per share) were not excluded.

notes: Release in USD thousands; reconciliation in $ millions. The reconciliation shows one 'Litigation settlements' row of 2,483 (income statement 2,482,845 thousand); the text splits it into American Express $1.65bn, Discover $827.5m (net) and California consumer case $6m (sum 2,483.5, rounding). Totals published: pre-tax 2,408, tax 914, net income +1,494, diluted EPS +11.40. Item ni COMPUTED: litigation 1,542 = 2,483 - 941 ('Impact of litigation settlements on income tax expense (benefit)' in the ETR reconciliation); gain -48 = 1,494 - 1,542 (residual). Per-item EPS not published (null). Self-checks: opex 5526 - 2483 = 3043 OK; oth 151 - 75 = 76 OK; ni -254 + 1542 - 48 = 1240 vs 1239 (rounding, OK); EPS -1.95 + 11.40 = 9.45 OK (total only). adj.etr 38.7 is the release's 'effective tax rate, excluding litigation settlements' (ETR reconciliation excludes litigation only; main-table adjusted tax 785/2025 = 38.8%, and the FY2009 release restates the 2008 non-GAAP ETR as 38.8%). The FY2009 release also revises 2008 EPS for the new share-based-payment EPS standard (GAAP -1.94, adjusted 9.41, special items 11.35); this record keeps the FY2008 release as originally reported. kpi: rev_g_cn null - currency 'contributed approximately 2.5 percentage points' (not stated as an FX-adjusted rate). gdv_g_local 10.7 from the twelve-month operating-performance table (text gives Q4 only: 3.4%). Full-year processed transactions / cross-border growth not stated in the release (Q4 processed transactions +6.0%). cards_bn 0.981 = 981 million MasterCard-branded cards. revcat: FY2008 10-K presents operations fees / assessments; lines sum to 4,992 = net revenue. Legacy recast of 2008 from the FY2009 10-K in fy_legacy_recast (sums to 4,992).
